target_statement: Derive an exact common-transform identity between Suzuki's shifted Psi_omega and the R95/R96 lambda=2 von Mangoldt ramp, and decide whether the connecting operator contains an independently provable one-sided margin.
claim_status_sought: EXACT_IDENTITY_OR_EQUIVALENCE plus either PROJECT_PROVED_THEOREM_WITH_SCOPE or a SYNTHETIC_COUNTERMODEL_OR_METHOD_OBSTRUCTION for proposed margin transfers
first_unproved_edge: Existence of an independently provable one-sided margin after the exact transform comparison
mask_or_node_class: Full von Mangoldt prime-power measure for exact transforms; in the alpha>1/2 shifted ramp, deleting proper prime powers changes the function by O_alpha(1), but that bounded correction must be retained in exact finite comparisons
source_data_retained: No QP/Turan source event is used; this is an independent explicit-formula/Landau architecture
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Actual nonnegative Lambda coefficients acted on by signed kernels; no arbitrary coefficient relaxation
normalization: R(x)=sum_{n<=x} Lambda(n)(2n/x-1)-1+x^{-1}; alpha=1/2+omega and Suzuki's published Psi_omega normalization
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Asymptotic t=log x to infinity; eventual sign for Psi_omega versus one fixed-power upper or lower envelope for R
quantifier_order: There exists fixed omega in (0,1/2) or a<1, then there exist constants/t0, and the inequality holds for every sufficiently large t or x
resolution_required: Exact Laplace/Mellin multiplier identity, including pole and archimedean completion; no finite-frequency truncation

all_exponent_losses: the original unweighted ramp has an O(x^{1/2} log x) prime-power loss, whereas the alpha>1/2 shifted ramp has an O_alpha(1) loss
every variable filter must pay its zero-mode attenuation
compact initial corrections are entire and asymptotically irrelevant

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: R and Psi_omega are explicit unconditional functions; Suzuki proves Psi_omega>=0 for omega>=1/2, while the diagnostic concerns 0<omega<1/2
downstream_socket: An independently proved eventual Psi_omega sign gives the half-plane Re(s)>alpha by Suzuki Theorem 11.1; an independently proved one-sided R=O(x^alpha) envelope gives it by the audited Landau theorem
parallel_open_siblings: zeta-specific adjacent-support propagation in the Weil architecture
why_not_target_renamed: The exact operator identity is unconditional and useful even if no sign margin follows; direct eventual positivity of Psi_omega itself is explicitly classified as the strip target, not an intermediate lemma.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Insert a single off-axis conjugate zero-mode or the R95 smooth positive oscillatory measure and test whether the proposed operator inequality preserves sign.
fejer_falsifier: Not native to this explicit-formula architecture; use oscillatory exponential modes as the corresponding multiplier-level smoke test.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Replace Lambda by a positive density 1+epsilon x^{beta-1} cos(gamma log x) and test any claimed generic margin.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: Evaluate both exact prime formulas at matched t, omega, and cutoffs with high precision; record only sign morphology and scale-normalized ratios.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any surviving proof must use a property of Lambda not shared by the positive oscillatory density or atomic countermodels, beyond positivity, density, convexity, and the standard Selberg-size identity.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: A genuinely independent positive remainder would become a new explicit-formula route to one fixed strip; the identity alone only unifies two equivalent targets.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Retire direct positivity-preserving comparison and treat shifted Psi and R as two coordinates on the same rightmost-zero obstruction.
stop_rule: Stop if the connecting map requires a cancellation or one-sided estimate with the same strip passport, or if an off-axis-mode/positive-density countermodel defeats every proposed generic margin.
